title: 第十一章上门威胁红脸白脸第十二章月黑风高杀人夜
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
母亲和阿妹都知道自己在后面的林间空地修炼，没什么事情是不会来打扰的。
现在，顾瑜的声音这么惶急。
难不成是父亲的伤情有变化？
“等一下，我马上就来！”
顾晦朝林子外喊了一声。
他很快收刀入鞘，把箭矢插回箭壶，背上猎弓，朝着林子外面走去。
林子外的斜坡上，顾瑜和一个人站在一起。
顾晦的瞳孔微微收缩，他下意识地眯起了眼睛，当他感到愤怒的时候才会这样。
那个人，顾晦认得。
觉醒前一起厮混的伙伴，和他一样都是刀疤六的跟班，在街面上厮混的二流子。
他叫归有德，比顾晦大两岁。
昨天，他也跟着刀疤六来了，最后好心建议顾晦早点把拜门费交给刀疤六的人就是他。
这会儿，他双手环抱在胸前，佝偻着背，像是在抵抗穿过竹林的寒风，身体抖个不停。
“阿兄，你朋友找你！”
顾瑜望着顾晦，小小的脸上满是忧虑。
阿兄好不容易变好了，不出去厮混，也不欺负自己，现在，他的朋友找来了，顾瑜很不开心。
顾晦走了过去，摸了摸顾瑜的脑袋：“阿妹，乖，回家去，阿兄等一会就回来……”
“阿兄，你要回来哈！”
“娘在做晚饭，你别……”
顾瑜担心地望着顾晦。

“嗯。”
“阿妹放心，阿兄哪儿都不去，等一会就回来，你先回家去吧，不要到处乱跑！”
顾晦笑着说道。
随后，望着顾瑜蹦蹦跳跳地跑下土坡，绕过围墙，往自家走去，他这才转过身，望向归有德。
“归老二，找我做啥？”
顾晦脸上带着笑，一如既往。
“哎！”
归有德叹了口气。
“老弟啊，我也不想来啊，不过，不得不来啊，老弟从来没有对不起过我，帮过老哥很多次，这一次不来的话，对不起良心！”
他的表情非常烦躁，抬手挠了挠头皮。
“什么事？”
顾晦不动声色地问道。
归有德扭头望了望左右，向前两步，小声说道：“老弟，你最好明天一早就把拜门费给刀疤六送过去，中午喝酒的时候，他给大伙儿说，要是你明天不给钱的话，他就带人找上门来……”
“以前，你爹在，他不敢乱来！”
“现在，他知道你爹重伤，站都站不起来，所以……”
说罢，归有德又叹了口气。
“我真后悔，以前不该带着你和他去厮混，以为找了个好大哥就不受欺负，没想到……”
content_en:
Both mother and A-mei knew that they were practicing in the forest clearing behind, and nothing would disturb them.
Now, Gu Yu's voice was so anxious.
Could it be that his father's injury condition has changed?
"Wait a minute, I'll come right away!"
Gu Hui shouted outside the forest.
He quickly sheathed the knife, put the arrows back into the quiver, put the hunting bow on his back, and walked out of the forest.
On the slope outside the forest, Gu Yu was standing with a person.
Gu Hui's pupils shrank slightly, and he subconsciously narrowed his eyes. He only did this when he felt angry.
Gu Hui recognized that person.
The partners he hung out with before his awakening were, like him, Scar Six's followers, second-rate guys hanging out on the street.
His name was Gui Youde, and he was two years older than Gu Hui.
Yesterday, he also came with Scar Liu, and he was the one who kindly suggested Gu Hui to pay the visit fee to Scar Liu as soon as possible.
At this moment, he folded his arms on his chest and hunched his back, as if resisting the cold wind passing through the bamboo forest, and his body was shaking non-stop.
"Brother, your friend is looking for you!"
Gu Yu looked at Gu Hui, her little face full of worry.
Brother Ah finally got better and stopped hanging out and bullying himself. Now, his friend came to find him, and Gu Yu was very unhappy.
Gu Hui walked over and touched Gu Yu's head: "Mei, be good and go home. Brother will be back in a while..."
"Brother, you have to come back!"
"Mom is making dinner, don't..."
Gu Yu looked at Gu Hui worriedly.
"Yeah."
"Don't worry, sister. Brother is not going anywhere. He will be back in a while. You go home first and don't run around!"
Gu Hui said with a smile.
Then, watching Gu Yu running down the slope, walking around the wall, and walking towards his home, he turned around and looked at Gui Youde.
"Gui Lao Er, what do you want from me?"
Gu Hui had a smile on his face, as always.
"Hey!"
Gui Youde sighed.
"Brother, I don't want to come either, but I have to come. I have never been sorry to me. I have helped me many times. If I don't come this time, I will be sorry for my conscience!"
His expression was very irritated, and he raised his hand to scratch his scalp.
"What's the matter?"
Gu Hui asked calmly.
Gui Youde turned around and looked around, took two steps forward, and whispered: "Brother, you'd better send the visiting fee to Scar Liu early tomorrow morning. When we were drinking at noon, he told everyone that if you don't give the money tomorrow, he will bring someone to find you..."
"In the past, when your father was here, he didn't dare to mess around!"
"Now, he knows that your father is seriously injured and can't stand up, so..."
After saying that, Gui Youde sighed again.
"I really regret that I shouldn't have taken you to hang out with him before. I thought that if I found a good big brother, I wouldn't be bullied. I didn't expect..."
